release.notes: HulaLetra now includes a downloadable word template and bulk CSV UTF-8 upload. Prepare Answer, Initial clue, Extra clue and Subject/topic in Excel; upload up to 100 words into a saved Question Bank set and select words without retyping. Invalid rows are reported before anything is saved. Includes the organized Class Games layout, named-subject choices and all previous features. Existing classroom records, settings and activation are preserved.
